long.text: Claim the lookout rock and be the first to see whoever comes up the beach.
long.reason: Anything with a view that high should belong to me, and I found it first.

steps.reason: I found this rock first, so I will sit on top of it and let the beach know.
Something on the sunny side of the beach smelled new, and I intend to investigate it without appearing interested.
Exploring is tiring, and a warm patch of sun is owed to me.
A cat should eat when it is convenient, and this is becoming convenient.
A stray leaf looked like it needed chasing, and I was not going to let it win.
From the sunny rock I can watch the whole beach without anyone noticing that I am watching.

today.reason: I will claim the lookout, investigate the sunny side, nap in the warmth, and keep the afternoon loose.
